home.heroTitle: Unlock, check and repair any phone.
home.heroSubtitle: Carrier unlocks, IMEI checks, tool credits and firmware services. Pay from your wallet and get refunded automatically if it can't be done.
home.howToPaySubtitle: Three steps. We follow every order for you.
home.step1Body: Pick the unlock, check or tool, then enter the IMEI (or several, one per line) and any details it asks for.
home.step2Body: Wallet, MonCash, NatCash, card or USDT, depending on your country.

home.trustSecureBody: Not done? The money goes back to your wallet automatically.

home.walletTitle: Top up once, order in one tap

faq.a1: Each service shows its real average time. IMEI checks are often instant; unlocks can take from a few hours to several days.
faq.q2: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: Your GSMLite wallet, plus the methods available in your country. They are shown at checkout.
faq.q3: Can I withdraw money from my wallet?
faq.a3: No. The wallet is store credit: top it up and spend it on any service.
faq.q4: What if my order can't be done?
faq.a4: If a phone is rejected or the service fails, its price goes back to your wallet automatically and you are notified.

pages.aboutBody: GSMLite is an online store for phone repair technicians and phone owners: carrier unlocks, IMEI checks, tool licenses and credits, data and firmware services. Orders are sent to trusted suppliers automatically and tracked until done.
pages.contactBody: The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp. You can also open a support request from any order.
guideMoncash: Choose MonCash at checkout or when adding money to your wallet.
You are sent to the MonCash page. Enter your MonCash phone number.
Enter the code MonCash sends you, then your PIN to approve.
You come back to GSMLite automatically. Your payment is confirmed in seconds.
guideNatcash: Choose NatCash at checkout or when adding money to your wallet.
Open NatCash and send the exact amount to the number shown.
Copy the transaction reference from the NatCash confirmation.
Enter the reference on GSMLite. Our team checks it, usually within 30 minutes.
pages.guidePlayerIdTitle: How to find your phone's IMEI
guidePlayerId: Dial *#06# on the phone: the IMEI appears on the screen.
Or open Settings › General › About (iPhone) or Settings › About phone (Android).
Copy all 15 digits exactly. A wrong IMEI can't be unlocked.
termsBody: GSMLite sells digital services for phones: carrier unlocks, IMEI checks, tool licenses and credits, data and firmware services.
You must enter the correct IMEI, serial number and details. GSMLite is not responsible for orders placed with wrong information.
Wallet balances are store credit. They can be spent on GSMLite and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.
We may hold or review payments and orders to prevent fraud.
Brand and tool names belong to their owners. GSMLite is an independent reseller.
privacyBody: We collect your name, email, optional phone number, order details (such as IMEIs) and payment references to provide the service.
License keys, identity documents and payment information are stored encrypted.
We do not sell your data. We share only what payment providers and service suppliers need to complete your order.
You can ask us to export or delete your data by contacting support.

We only use necessary cookies: your sign-in, your language, a referral code if you followed an invite, and an anonymous browser ID that helps us stop fraud with multiple accounts. No advertising cookies.
refundsBody: If a service can't be done, its price goes back to your GSMLite wallet automatically.
License keys and results that have been delivered cannot be refunded.
Orders placed with a wrong IMEI or wrong details may not be refundable once processed.
Contact us on WhatsApp with your order number for any problem.
